_what_this_is: Invented returns. They describe no company, no index and no day that ever traded. The arithmetic they prove is documented in .superpowers/sdd/2026-08-17-v5-session0/phase5-estimator-design.md section 4.

estimation._rule: benchmark b_i = 0.002 * ((i mod 5) - 2); company r_i = 0.001 + 1.5 * b_i, EXACTLY. OLS over points on a straight line recovers alpha=0.001, beta=1.5 exactly.

event_window._rule: offset 0 is the shock day and is INCLUDED in every CAR window.
event_window.quiet_tail_rule: offsets 6..20 carry company = 0.001 + 1.5 * benchmark, so every abnormal return there is exactly 0.

shock_series._rule: 24 daily moves: ten at +1%, ten at -1%, two at +3%, two at -3%. Mean exactly 0. Population variance = (20*0.0001 + 4*0.0009)/24 = 0.000233333...; sigma = 0.0152752523..., 1.5*sigma = 0.0229128785...
shock_series._dedupe_note: the +3% at index 4 and the +3% at index 9 are five sessions apart and both survive; the -3% pair at indexes 14 and 19 likewise. The dedupe rule is exercised separately by a two-day pair built in the test.
